FIELDS.NAME: Lullaby Linen & Diaper Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Lullaby Linen & Diaper Services provides high-quality diaper and linen rental and laundering services to both residential and commercial clients. Our primary operations include the collection, washing, drying, folding, and delivery of clean linens and diapers, ensuring they meet the highest hygiene standards. We utilize state-of-the-art automated washing and drying equipment to maintain efficiency and minimize manual handling, greatly reducing the risk of employee injuries. Our facility adheres to strict compliance with OSHA regulations, and we conduct regular safety training for all staff to ensure a safe working environment. Additionally, we implement comprehensive maintenance schedules for our equipment to prevent any operational disruptions. Our commitment to environmental sustainability is reflected in our practices, including responsible chemical use and waste disposal. Overall, our operations are designed to provide exceptional service while prioritizing safety and compliance.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Lullaby Baby Supplies LLC, 4567 Cuddle Avenue, Springfield, IL 62701-2345 - A retail operation providing baby products, such as diapers, wipes, and feeding supplies, with a focus on eco-friendly options and exceptional customer service.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred due to water damage from a plumbing issue on 06/15/2022, amounting to $1,500.00, currently resolved as all damages have been repaired and processes adjusted to prevent future occurrences. Also, a minor equipment failure led to loss on 09/05/2022, amounting to $1,000.00, resolved with the replacement of the faulty machinery.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard Class A Safe, Grade 1, UL Listed for storage of cash and valuables.
